about: Planet data for terrain (W1, docs/design/world-and-blocks.md section 2). One file per planet dimension: the file name is the dimension path. Sizes follow docs/science/mars-terrain-reference.md (SME). Every number here is INVENTED game scale unless a note says otherwise; compressed sizes are labelled 'stylised' in the journal. Block ids are data so the Artist or SME can change a colour without code.

wind.note: ONE fixed wind direction for the whole planet (owner decision). Compass degrees, 0 = north (-z), 90 = east (+x), clockwise; the direction the wind blows TOWARD. Dune slip faces face this way; the gentle windward slopes face the opposite way. INVENTED value. The density functions do not use it (dunes are shaped by mars.terrain.DuneField).

pad.note: Flat starting pad around x=0, z=0 (the /mars go arrival). Inside flat_radius the top block is exactly height_y; it blends to the natural ground by ramp_radius. INVENTED. height_y matches the base ground of the noise settings (base_height in worldgen/noise_settings/mars_planet.json).

shape.note: Small craters: depth = ratio x diameter, ratio 0.10 (old, filled) to 0.20 (fresh) (SME row 3; the 0.2 is NOT VERIFIED). rim_ratio 0.05 x diameter (SME 0.04 to 0.05, NOT VERIFIED). min_rim_blocks raises tiny rims to one block so they show at 1 m resolution (INVENTED aid). Profile: bowl z = -d(1-(r/R)^2), rim d exp(-((r-R)/(0.15R))^2), ejecta h (R/r)^3 out to reach_radii x R (SME note 5.2; shape INVENTED, real profiles NOT VERIFIED).

craters.small_levels_note: One level per diameter octave; roughly 5 times more craters each time the diameter halves (SME row 3, INVENTED shape of a real many-small-few-big trend). The two smallest levels were thinned after the first screenshots (0.38 and 0.30 looked like noise). Expected about 0.6 craters of 16 to 32 blocks per 100 x 100 blocks. A level places at most one crater per cell, so cells are at least 3.5 times the largest radius. All INVENTED.

large.note: Large complex craters: flat floor, central peak, shallower (SME row 4: depth 0.08 to 0.10, floor 40 to 60 percent of the width, peak 5 to 10 percent of the diameter; the percentages are NOT VERIFIED). GAME CHOICE (stylised): real change-over is at 3 to 8 km (Pike 1980, verified); compressed about 25 times, so 120 to 300 blocks stand for 3 to 7.5 km. Label 'stylised' in the journal.

fixed.note: Two small craters in view of the dome pad (SME note 5.3). Coordinates INVENTED.

dunes.note: Transverse dunes in fields 100 to 300 blocks wide (SME rows 6, 7: heights 3 to 15, length 20 to 100; NOT VERIFIED). Wavelength varies by up to about 25 percent (wavelength_variation) through a smooth phase offset on a 180-block scale (variation_scale), so crests bend but are not sheared (a position-dependent wavelength was tried first and sheared them). Ripples: lighter stripe 1 block wide every 3 blocks across the wind (ripple_period, ripple_width), on dune columns, with the block named in surface.ripple_block (Curiosity ripples about 3 m apart, VERIFIED; the stripe block is ripple_sand, a muted tan (first duricrust, which was the same colour idea); red sand stripes read as a zebra barcode and gravel stripes were too bright (both seen in screenshots)). windward_fraction 0.78: the gentle side takes 78 percent of a wavelength, the slip face 22 percent, so with 6 blocks of height the gentle side is about 12 degrees and the slip face about 36 degrees (SME 10 and 30 degrees; angle of repose on Mars NOT VERIFIED). Height max kept at 8 (SME range to 15) to respect the 3 to 6 relief budget of the plains. All INVENTED.

surface.note: Top block overrides. Dust and plains patches come from the noise settings' surface rule. Rim and ejecta are impact breccia (W2, SME materials row 19, REAL: NTRS 20170006943); colours are a first guess for the Artist and SME: 'lighter or rockier material' (SME row 3). Dune sand is dark (Curiosity report, VERIFIED in the SME reference).

buttes.note: W2: no buttes near the dome pad. Inside keep_out_inner ground above pad height + cap_above_pad is cut down to the cap (plains relief stays); the cut fades to nothing by keep_out_outer. Cut columns get dust over duricrust. INVENTED distances: the pad is 32 flat / 60 ramp, so the first butte starts 130 to 220 blocks away (about two minutes of walking).

canyon.note: W2 STYLISED canyon, the one canyon of the planet, label it 'stylised, shrunk to fit the game' (SME note 5.4). Real Valles Marineris is about 4000 km long and 7 km deep (not re-verified here); the owner asked for about 1000 long, 60 to 100 deep and 200 to 400 wide. Depth is 60 (the low end): the dimension floor is y 0 and the ground is y 80, so 100 would not fit without a new dimension type (that would break existing saves). Straight trench with a wandering centre line, flat floor (floor_fraction of the half width), terraced walls (bench_height blocks per step) with terracotta colour bands, tapered ends. About 600 blocks from the pad, outside the butte keep-out. INVENTED placement and shape.

rocks.note: Chance per column of a one-block rock on crater rims and ejecta, 10 to 100 times the plain's cover (SME section 2; numbers INVENTED). Plain and flat rock fields are datapack features (worldgen/placed_feature/boulders_*.json).
